name: Gergely
headline: Turn Luxair’s booking data into travellers who fly again.
saw: Your homepage sells Fly SMART fares, 90+ destinations from 89€, business class and Miles and More offers to every visitor the same way, whether they arrive as a family, a business traveller or a holiday buyer.

Once a customer has booked, what they fly, which destinations they repeat, when they book and which offers they ignore is your strongest signal for the next trip. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.
Retention and cross-sell campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. The traveller about to lapse this week gets the same Fly SMART offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the lapse before it happens
cases.text: Lapse signals per traveller from booking gaps, unopened offers and loyalty activity. The right offer, channel and moment picked for each customer, tested continuously across email and the website.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Upgrade the right travellers, not everyone
cases.text: Next best fare, seat or business class offer per customer, based on how they book. Miles and More and Luxair PRO offers reach the people they fit, not everyone.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep travellers booking between trips
cases.text: Personal destination ideas per customer, triggered by past trips and what they open. Sent by email and on the homepage, so each traveller has a reason to return.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
